leg_name: wA666 return burn and certified PFTL import
fire_hash_confirmation: PENDING-FIRE-TIME: SHA-256 must equal authorization-binding-native-v1.json before one execution.
preconditions: 6/6 fleet agrees on postfiat-wan-devnet-2 and the pinned genesis hash
route is live and unpaused at route epoch 6
E5 pricing reserve packet hash equals 78c9fce35e0dc1ad9a7bd5b25b34e432c606fc38889e1543d5242cff12fe637bb0a508aff3655d2e2e27ac872f88f289
packet SHA-256 equals the fire-time native authorization binding entry
native replay read is clean for this packet idempotency key
abort_conditions: any state read disagrees across required quorum
any receipt, finality height, or state root is missing or mismatched
any replay or duplicate idempotency record exists
any amount, route, epoch, asset, recipient, or signer differs from this packet
any deviation anywhere: STOP-no-retry; HOLD all subsequent legs
state_reads: fleet postfiat-node rpc status: six-of-six chain, height, tip, and state root
fleet postfiat-node rpc account_assets for the packet owner/subscriber
fleet postfiat-node rpc receipts, tx, and batch_archive for finality
cast eth_call through two public Ethereum RPCs
Ethereum block, receipt, code, balance, allowance, and event-log reads

receipt_gate.required: Ethereum ReturnBurned receipt status=1 and block; certified pftl_uniswap_return_import tx_ids; receipt.accepted=true; finalized height/state root; imported A666 delta equals burned amount

custody_signing_leaf.kind: constrained signer socket for burn plus PFTL operator/validator key files for import

economics.rule: Leg 1 is the sole principal spend. Recompute gas at fire time; projection above cap is STOP-no-retry.

budget_guard.resolution_policy: fire-time binding step computes fresh gas quote (current base fee x gas limit x ETH/USD), writes it into the fire-time authorized binding, driver enforces prior_actual + fresh_quote <= 530.000000 else STOP-no-retry
budget_guard.driver_rule: execution with unresolved PENDING-FIRE-TIME ceiling on a spend leg is STOP-no-retry

command_template: PHASE 1 (one execution): env POSTFIAT_SIGNER_SOCKET=/run/user/1000/postfiat-constrained-signer/a666-signer.sock python3 scripts/a666-mainnet-burn-for-return.py --execute --amount-atoms <PENDING-FIRE-TIME:leg3h-wa666-output-atoms> --return-nonce <PENDING-FIRE-TIME:return-nonce> --ethereum-sender 0x1455Bd7FBfBF92a171eF36025E13959E3b0ad8c0 --pftl-recipient pfab9b9228942e5c529633a13aa271d5297bec6353. Require the status-1 burn receipt. PHASE 2: driver injects the phase-1 tx_hash as burn_event_hash and submits pftl_uniswap_return_import through pftl-submit-certified-asset-ops. Any phase mismatch is STOP-no-retry.
requires: fresh return nonce and replay-clean import
supersedes: live-demo/v4/v5 packet set preserved as superseded evidence; never execute it.
